description: List TLS certificates issued for a domain name: id, matching names, issuer, serial number and validity dates. By default matches the exact name; set include_subdomains to true to also match every name under it. Covers certificates valid now or expired within the last 90 days unless archive is set to "full" or a year from 2013 (needs an API key on the Pro plan). Pass a row's id to get_certificate for the full record. To list hostnames rather than certificates, use find_subdomains.

archive.description: "full" for all certificates since 2013, or a four-digit year from 2013 for certificates valid into that year or later; needs an API key on the Pro plan. Omit for certificates valid now or expired within the last 90 days

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous call, to get the next page; omit for the first page

domain.description: A bare DNS name such as example.com, without a scheme, path or port

include_subdomains.description: true also matches every name under the domain

name: search_certificates
title: Search certificates by domain
